metadata.Name: PIQA
metadata.Description: A dataset for physical commonsense reasoning, containing multiple-choice questions about everyday situations.
Provider: Paul G. Allen School for Computer Science and Engineering, University of Washington
metadata.Paper Title: PIQA: Reasoning about Physical Commonsense in Natural Language
metadata.Venue Title: Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence
Affiliations: Paul G. Allen School for Computer Science and Engineering, University of Washington
metadata.Abstract: To apply eyeshadow without a brush, should I use a cotton swab or a toothpick? Questions requiring this kind of physical commonsense pose a challenge to today's natural language understanding systems. In this paper, we introduce the task of physical commonsense reasoning and a corresponding benchmark dataset Physical Interaction: Question Answering or PIQA. Though humans find the dataset easy (95% accuracy), large pretrained models struggle (~77%). We provide analysis about the dimensions of knowledge that existing models lack, which offers significant opportunities for future research.
